name: wed
description: A free wedding website template for beginners. Browser setup, simple guides and copy-paste AI prompts. GitHub and Cloudflare Free.

scripts.dev: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/check.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run deploy:dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run deploy:dry-run && node scripts/deploy.mjs
